title: Effects of Si additions on microstructures and mechanical properties of VNbTiTaSi*x* refractory high-entropy alloys
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting under argon atmosphere with high purity (> 99.95 wt%) V, Nb, Ti, Ta, and Si, re-melted for at least ten times with electromagnetic stirring to ensure chemical homogeneity
